asked_questions: Which service touchpoint or environment should this redesign cover, and what should stay out of scope?
How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?

user_answers.question: Which service touchpoint or environment should this redesign cover, and what should stay out of scope?
user_answers.answer: Scope the redesign to the standalone calibration-report runtime: policies, decision-outcome pairs, cohort records, consequence classification, aggregate consequence assessment, verifier rules, examples, fixtures, docs, and release evidence. Keep other package types, UI, external integrations, production data, and automatic deployment authority out of scope.

user_answers.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
user_answers.answer: Success means another human or AI can reproduce how each forecast crosses a governed action threshold, classify false assurance versus false alarm against an explicit loss boundary, reproduce consequence-weighted arithmetic, and force governance when a severe false-assurance boundary is crossed. Counts, monetary values, weights, thresholds, and scores remain evidence, never quality or semantic truth.
